summary: Esperion Therapeutics (ESPR) filed an 8-K confirming the HSR waiting period expired on June 15, 2026, for its pending acquisition by an affiliate of ArchiMed SAS (Parent). Under the Merger Agreement dated May 1, 2026, MergerCo will merge into Esperion, with Esperion surviving as a wholly owned subsidiary of Parent; per prior disclosure, stockholders will receive $15.00 per share in cash, implying a premium of ~112% over the unaffected price, with an additional CVR of up to $5.00 per share contingent on milestones. The board recommended adoption, with no advisor named in this filing. The deal requires stockholder approval at a special meeting on July 8, 2026. Regulatory risk cleared; watch stockholder vote and closing timetable.
